_about: Pricing criteria for eff engagements. Every fee is COMPUTED from these factors, never quoted from a table — so any two clients with the same profile get the same price, and every line of a quote can be defended. Edit this file to reprice the whole business.
_rate_about: The one number everything scales from. Change it and every quote moves.
_effort_about: Days of work, built bottom-up. per_asset_days is the real driver: reviewing one machine's data, chasing what is missing, and interpreting its result.
_modifiers_about: Multipliers on total effort. Each one names a real cost driver, not a negotiating tactic.

data_readiness._note: How much chasing the data will need. Judged from the first call, stated in the quote.

urgency._note: Expedited compresses the timeline and displaces other work.

diversity._note: Many distinct equipment classes means more baselines and units to handle.

multi_language._note: Bilingual reporting is standard and carries no premium. A third language does.

_discounts_about: Applied after modifiers, in this order, and always shown as separate lines.
_tiers_about: What is being bought. proof_of_concept is deliberately tiny and is what the Founding Client Programme covers.
_retainer_about: Continuous monitoring, priced off the baseline it follows so the two can never drift apart.
_value_check_about: A sanity band, not a pricing rule. A defensible fee lands between 1% and 3% of what the fleet spends on energy in a year. Outside that band the quote is flagged for review - too low leaves value on the table, too high will not survive a CFO.
_addons_about: Priced per unit, never bundled into the base fee.
